coordinate_contract.web_schema: Existing object IDs/categories/routes retained; indexed vertex arrays with per-vertex source-surface normals.

claims_boundary: All checks are limited to stated geometric/numerical/export scopes. No physical hardware, sorting performance, safety, certification or operating capacity was validated.
handoff: Use exports with this exact web mesh and current candidate drawings. Preserve predecessor public af611cd and old engineering release separately. Drawing/BOM/browser verification are separate workstreams.

physical_flow.status: Static intake spans and nominal routing topology checked; moving-particle capture, accepted-feed, gate sealing and sorting-performance remain design holds.
physical_flow.paper_wording: The preliminary CAD uses a two-stream pneumatic split followed by a separate group review gate on the non-ejected balance stream. Both primary catch mouths span the nominal belt width with extra lateral allowance; explicit tapered walls collect material into downstream channels. The revised gate topology and branch surfaces are modeled, with finite operating clearances remaining an unresolved leakage and accepted-feed hold. Three collection bins represent proposed destinations, not demonstrated independent per-object three-way sorting. Feed inhibition, clearing, motion and verified position are required before resuming feed; no physical validation has been performed. Moving-particle capture is a design hold. A gravity-only 1.5 m/s horizontal point launch at x=3000, z=1000 mm and y=275 mm crosses the converging cheek at x=3174.64 mm, z=933.51 mm; the wall top is 863.21 mm (about 70 mm below). Existing side guards at y=±525 mm do not collect that interior path. This analytical counterexample is not a measured trial. Intake width does not prove capture. No operating speed or full-width no-jet capture route is approved; all displayed paths and motion speeds are schematic until receiving containment and physical trials resolve this hold.

primary_stage.function: One pneumatic bank proposes target ejection versus non-ejected balance.
primary_stage.pitch_status: Geometric study assumption; not validated separation resolution.
primary_stage.control_status: One generic valve envelope per nozzle is drawn, but circuit, driver, plumbing, independence, impulse and response are unselected/unverified.

ejected_destination.function: Proposed PCB-rich target concentrate; no contents or grade established.

non_ejected_destination.function: Feeds the separate downstream balance/review gate.

secondary_gate.input: Only material remaining in the non-ejected balance stream.
secondary_gate.drawn_transition_status: The static centered blade is a transition depiction, not an allowed feeding state.

actuator.energy_source: Not selected; CAD does not establish pneumatic versus electric actuation.

position_sensing.status: Unselected and unwired; no measured position feedback or safety integrity established.

secondary_gate.operating_intent: Conservative group/window routing, including neighboring candidates where necessary. Inhibit feed, establish a measured clearing interval, move the gate, verify its position, then resume. Suppress conflicting target ejections during the review window.
secondary_gate.limitation: Cannot recover material already ejected into concentrate; physical residence time, bounce, gate dynamics, throughput penalty, restart logic and fail states remain unvalidated.

implemented: Executable parametric CAD solids, STEP/GLB/web exports and static section drawings.
Geometric gate sweep and illustrative route-clearance checks.
Synthetic viewer sequence showing feed/drain/gate-change/review/restore phases.
proposed_unvalidated: Purchased actuator, valve and switch selection.
Working pneumatic/electrical circuits and position feedback.
Real-object routing, safe guarding, control/safety functions and physical mass-recovery testing.

evidence.scope: Current source-solid gate sweep, full-width intake/funnel/branch geometry and bin-mouth checks. Illustrative corridors are not physical trajectories or accepted fragment bounds.

repeated_observation_and_hold_consistenc.physical_object_identity: Repeated views or frames of the same object must not be counted as independent physical samples. Future development and blind evaluation must separate physical object and source-lot identities.
repeated_observation_and_hold_consistenc.viewer_markers: Repeated moving markers and the cyclic gate sequence are synthetic illustrations, not recordings, predictions, test repetitions, measured throughput or gate timing.
repeated_observation_and_hold_consistenc.gate_hold_status: Gate actuator, switch model, full circuit, clearing interval, failure behavior and control/safety validation remain design holds. Geometric clearance PASS does not resolve those holds.
